mapper.select: SELECT /*selectMasterMdAmUserManageDetailList*/ X.USER_ID, X.AUTH_ID, X.AUTH_NAME, X.AUTH_DC, X.ROLE_FLAG, X.USE_FLAG, X.CREATE_DT FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID, A.AUTH_ID, B.NAME AS AUTH_NAME, B.AUTH_DC, B.ROLE_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG, A.CREATE_DT FROM KX_USERAUTH A, KX_AUTHINFO B WHERE A.AUTH_ID = B.AUTH_ID UNION SELECT A.USER_ID, A.ROLE_ID AS AUTH_ID, B.NAME AS AUTH_NAME, B.AUTH_DC, B.ROLE_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG, A.CREATE_DT FROM KX_USERROLE A, KX_AUTHINFO B WHERE A.ROLE_ID = B.AUTH_ID ) X WHERE 1=1 AND X.USER_ID = #{st_user_id_detail} ORDER BY ROLE_FLAG, X.AUTH_NAME
mapper.update: /*insertMasterMdAmUserManageDetail*/ INSERT INTO KX_USERAUTH ( USER_ID, AUTH_ID, CREATE_DT, USE_FLAG )VALUES ( #{USER_ID}, #{AUTH_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USE_FLAG} )
/*insertMasterMdAmUserManageDetail*/ INSERT INTO KX_USERROLE ( USER_ID, ROLE_ID, CREATE_DT, USE_FLAG )VALUES ( #{USER_ID}, #{AUTH_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USE_FLAG} )
